top_jobs.job: When I sell on Amazon or TikTok Shop, or am asked to, help me decide which products go where, at what price and with what ads, so each marketplace adds profit and not just sales
top_jobs.metric: contribution margin per unit by marketplace and product, after all fees, trailing 30 days

top_jobs.job: When a health warning, a suppressed listing or a reseller hits a top product, help me see it the same day and fix it, so I do not lose the account, the Buy Box or a week of sales
top_jobs.metric: order defect rate against the limit, suppressed top listings, and Buy Box win rate

top_jobs.job: When the payout lands short or fees creep up, help me find every dollar owed and claim it before the window closes, so the money comes back
top_jobs.metric: settlement shortfall and reimbursement owed but not claimed, monthly

top_jobs.job: When marketplace shoppers ask, review and complain in their own words, help me use those words to fix listings and feed our ads, and bring ad winners back to the listing, so every channel sells with what buyers already told us
top_jobs.metric: unit buy rate and star rating per top product, trailing 30 days

jobs.job: Write the Amazon plan per product: margin per unit after referral fee, fulfilment fee, storage, returns and ads, next to site margin, then mark each product list, bundle only or do not list, with a price floor
jobs.trigger: once before listing, then each quarter

inputs.need: fee preview and size tier per product
ad cost of sale on Amazon today

steps: List each product with price, landed cost, size tier and weight
Compute margin per unit after every fee and ads at today's cost of sale
Set it next to site margin and a 30 percent floor from the idea bank, which the founder can change
Mark each product: list, list only in a bundle, or do not list
Set a price floor per product that keeps the Amazon price at or above the site price
Founder signs the plan
jobs.output: a signed product by channel plan with margin per unit and price floors

watch.metric: contribution margin per unit by marketplace and product, after all fees

jobs.job: Write the TikTok Shop plan: pick 3 to 5 products that sell on impulse, set shop price and creator commission inside the margin, send samples to 20 creators, and keep or cut each creator after 30 days on sales
jobs.trigger: once to launch, then a 30 day read

inputs.need: creator fit rules and past creators

steps: Pick 3 to 5 products under about $40 that show well in 15 seconds
Set the shop price and a commission of 10 to 20 percent that keeps margin above the floor
List 40 creators by fit, audience quality and past shop sales, and a person picks 20
Send samples with a 1 page brief: the hook that works on Meta, the claim rules, the offer
Track videos posted, views, orders and margin per creator for 30 days
Keep the top 5, cut the rest, and log what the winning videos share
jobs.output: a live shop with 3 to 5 products, 20 creators seeded, and a 30 day keep or cut list
jobs.next: feeds 09-creative (creator hooks) and 22-measurement (TikTok Shop in total sales)

watch.metric: TikTok Shop orders and margin per creator

jobs.job: Write a 1 page go or no go memo before adding a marketplace: 90 days of fees, stock needed, staff hours and the site sales it may take, next to what the current marketplaces earn per staff hour
jobs.trigger: when someone proposes a new marketplace

inputs.need: team hours spent in each seller portal
fee schedule of the new marketplace
inputs.from: public fee page typed into a sheet

steps: Compute margin per staff hour for each live marketplace from last quarter
Model the new one at 3 sales levels: fees, ads, stock and hours
Estimate site sales it may take, from price gaps and buyer overlap
Write the memo: the number, the risk, and what we stop doing to make time
Founder decides, and the decision is logged
jobs.output: a 1 page memo with a go or no go, and the founder's logged decision

watch.metric: contribution margin per marketplace per staff hour
watch.source: settlement reports and team time log

jobs.drives: time and cash spent on channels that pay

jobs.job: Check marketplace prices against site prices for the top 20 products every week, counting coupons and resellers, and flag any gap more than 5 percent below the site
jobs.trigger: every Monday

inputs.from: Amazon Seller Central and TikTok Shop

steps: Pull the final price a buyer pays on each channel, after coupons
Compute the gap to the site price
Flag gaps over 5 percent and say who set them: us, a coupon, or a reseller
Draft the fix: raise the coupon floor, end the deal, or report the reseller
jobs.output: a weekly price gap table with a fix for each flag

watch.metric: price gap between site and each marketplace per top product

jobs.job: Cut Amazon campaigns that spend more than the product earns: set each product's break-even ad cost of sale from its margin, list campaigns and search terms above it for 14 days, and draft negatives and bid cuts
jobs.trigger: every Monday

inputs.need: campaigns and search terms with spend and sales

steps: Break-even ad cost of sale = margin before ads divided by price
List campaigns over break-even for 14 days, with spend and sales
List search terms with spend over 2 times the product's cost per sale and no sale, as negatives
Draft bid cuts and negatives in a sheet, and a person applies them
Recheck in 14 days and log the change
jobs.output: a draft list of negatives and bid cuts per campaign, applied by a person

watch.metric: ad cost of sale per campaign against the product's break-even

jobs.job: Say yes or no to a Prime Day or Lightning Deal invite with one number: margin per unit at the deal price after the deal fee and ads, units needed, and stock left after
jobs.trigger: when a deal invite arrives
steps: Compute margin per unit at the deal price after fees and ads
Compute units needed to cover the fee, and stock left for 30 days after
Compare with the last 2 deals' lift and the dip that followed
Write yes or no with the number, and the founder decides
jobs.output: a yes or no note with margin per unit, units needed and stock left

watch.metric: contribution margin per unit at the deal price

jobs.job: Check account health every day (order defect rate, late shipment, cancel rate, valid tracking and policy notices) against the limits, alert at half the limit, and draft the reply with cause and fix
jobs.trigger: daily, and on every notice

inputs.from: Amazon Seller Central and Walmart Seller Center

inputs.need: who may send replies and change the account

steps: Pull each health number and its limit
Alert when any number passes half its limit, or when a notice lands
Find the orders behind the number: late, cancelled, no tracking, claim
Draft the plan of action: the cause, the fix done, and the fix that stops it again
A named person reviews and sends it
jobs.output: a daily health line and a drafted reply for each notice

watch.metric: order defect rate and late shipment rate against the limits

jobs.job: Each morning list every top product that is suppressed, has an open listing error or holds the Buy Box under 90 percent, with the seller who holds it and the ad spend still running
jobs.trigger: every morning

inputs.need: hourly Buy Box checks, if wanted

steps: Pull suppressed and errored listings and read each error
Pull yesterday's Buy Box share per product
Join ad spend per product
Write the fix for each problem: the missing field, the image, or the seller to report
A person makes the fix and pauses ads on products with no Buy Box
jobs.output: a morning list: product, problem, fix, and ad spend at risk

watch.metric: suppressed top listings, and Buy Box win rate per advertised product

jobs.job: Find every seller on our listings each week, test buy from any selling below our floor, and file a Brand Registry report with the proof
jobs.trigger: every Monday

inputs.need: offers and sellers on our listings

inputs.from: Amazon Brand Registry, needs a trademark

steps: List sellers and prices on each of our listings
Mark authorised sellers from the founder's list
Test buy from the worst unauthorised seller and photograph what arrives
A person files the report with the photos, the order and the listing
Recheck 7 days later
jobs.output: a seller list, test buy proof, and filed reports

watch.metric: unauthorised sellers on our listings
watch.source: Amazon Seller Central and Brand Registry

jobs.drives: Buy Box share, and bad reviews from fakes

jobs.job: Keep a register of every safety certificate, test report and label each product needs on each marketplace, with expiry dates, and alert 60 days before one runs out
jobs.trigger: monthly, and when a listing is pulled
steps: List each product and marketplace, and the documents each needs
Link each document with its issue and expiry date
Mark documents missing or expiring within 60 days
Send the list to the owner with the lab or supplier to ask
jobs.output: a document register with gaps and owners

watch.metric: listings with a missing or expired compliance document
watch.source: brain document register and marketplace notices

jobs.job: Rebuild each Amazon, Walmart and TikTok Shop payout from orders, fee by fee, compare it with what landed, and list every gap over $50 with the line it sits on
jobs.trigger: on every settlement

inputs.from: Amazon Seller Central and TikTok Shop
Amazon Seller Central and TikTok Shop

steps: Pull the settlement and every order, refund and fee in it
Compute the expected payout from orders and the fee schedule
Line up expected and actual, fee by fee
List gaps over $50 with the order and fee line, plus any reserve held and its release date
A person opens a case for each gap and logs the outcome
jobs.output: a reconciliation per settlement with gaps, reserves and cases opened

watch.metric: settlement shortfall: expected minus actual payout

jobs.job: Reconcile Amazon warehouse units sent, received, sold, returned and on hand each month, and list units lost, damaged or refunded but never returned, with the claim deadline for each
jobs.trigger: monthly
steps: Line up units per product through each step
Flag gaps: received short, lost in the warehouse, damaged, refunded with no return in 45 days
Value each gap and mark its claim deadline
Draft each claim with the shipment id and proof, and a person files it
Log money back each month
jobs.output: a monthly claim list with value and deadlines, and money recovered

watch.metric: reimbursement owed and not yet claimed

jobs.job: Check each product's Amazon size tier and weight against a measured box, dispute wrong tiers, and redesign packaging where one size tier down saves more than it costs
jobs.trigger: once, then on every new product or fee change

inputs.need: measured size and weight of 3 units per product
inputs.from: founder, with a tape and a scale

inputs.need: Amazon's recorded size and fee per product
a quote for a smaller box

steps: Measure 3 units per product and log the numbers
Compare them with Amazon's size and fee
Open a case wherever Amazon's numbers are bigger
For products within 1 inch of the next tier down, price a smaller box against the fee saved per year
jobs.output: a size tier table, cases opened, and a packaging change list

watch.metric: change in fulfilment fee per unit, per product

jobs.job: Plan Amazon stock each week: days of cover against restock lead time, units over 150 days old, and the storage limit, and choose which products get the space before Q4
jobs.trigger: every Monday, and when Amazon changes the storage limit

inputs.need: Amazon stock, stock age and storage limits
lead time to get stock into Amazon

steps: Compute days of cover per product at Amazon against lead time
List units over 150 days old and the date their fee starts
Rank products by profit per cubic foot
Give the space to the top products, and plan removal or price cuts for aged units
A person books the shipments
jobs.output: a weekly Amazon stock plan: send, hold or remove, per product

watch.metric: top products with fewer days of stock at Amazon than lead time

jobs.job: Build the Amazon question coverage matrix: every question from customer questions, buyer messages, reviews and our helpdesk in rows, and title, bullets, images, A+ page and FAQ in columns, then fill the 10 biggest blanks
jobs.trigger: once per top product, then monthly

inputs.need: Amazon customer questions and buyer messages

steps: Pull the questions, merge duplicates and count them
Mark where each is answered in the listing: title, bullets, images, A+ page, or nowhere
Rank blanks by count and by how close to buying they are
Write each answer as a bullet line or an image caption, and a person checks it against the claims shelf
Update the listing and log the date to compare buy rate
jobs.output: a matrix per product, and a listing update with 10 answers placed
jobs.next: feeds 20-19 (sales drop check) and 15-06 (site question matrix)

watch.metric: unit buy rate per top product

jobs.job: Turn Amazon reviews into Meta ads: pull 4 and 5 star reviews, take the buyers' exact words for before and after, tag each by avatar and awareness level, and write 10 hooks and 3 review ads to launch as one test
jobs.trigger: once a month

inputs.need: awareness levels where we run fewest ads
Meta results to judge the test

steps: Pull 4 and 5 star reviews from the last 12 months
Cut each into the before state, the result and the exact phrase, and tag by avatar and awareness level
Pick phrases for the awareness level where we run the fewest ads
Write 10 hooks in the buyer's words and 3 static review ads that show the star rating as it is on Amazon
Founder approves every claim and quote
A person launches them on Meta as one test, and the result goes to the win and loss ledger
jobs.output: 10 hooks and 3 approved ads, launched as one test

watch.metric: cost per new customer of the review ads against the account average

jobs.job: Move Meta winners onto Amazon: take the top 3 Meta angles by cost per new customer, rewrite the listing's title, first bullet and 2 images around them, and run an A/B test in Amazon's listing test tool
jobs.trigger: each quarter

inputs.need: top Meta ads by cost per new customer over 90 days
Brand Registry and the listing test tool

steps: Pick the top 3 angles on Meta by cost per new customer over 90 days
Write a title and first bullet for each, inside Amazon's rules
Design 2 listing images per angle from real product photos
A person sets up the test for 8 weeks
Keep the winner, and send the result to the win and loss ledger
jobs.output: a live listing test with 2 versions, and a readout

watch.metric: unit buy rate on the tested product

jobs.job: Mine the 1 to 3 star reviews of the top 5 rival products on Amazon, group the complaints, mark which ones we solve, and add a comparison image to our listing and 3 lines to our ads
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then each quarter

inputs.from: a review export tool, or copied by hand

steps: Pull 100 low star reviews per rival
Group the complaints and count them
Mark each: we solve it (with proof), same problem, or unknown
Draft a comparison image on 3 solved complaints, with no rival names or logos
Write 3 ad lines, and the founder approves every claim
jobs.output: a complaint table for 5 rivals, 1 comparison image and 3 ad lines

watch.metric: unit buy rate on our listing

jobs.job: When marketplace sales fall, split units into visits and buy rate per top product week on week, then check rank on the top 10 search terms, price, Buy Box, reviews and stock, and write the 1 line cause
jobs.trigger: when units fall 15 percent week on week

inputs.need: visits and unit buy rate per product

inputs.from: Brand Analytics, or a rank tracker

inputs.need: price, Buy Box and stock history

steps: Split the drop into fewer visits or a lower buy rate
If visits fell, check rank on the top terms, ad spend and impressions
If buy rate fell, check price changes, Buy Box share, new bad reviews and sizes out of stock
Write the cause in 1 line with the fix, and a person owns it
jobs.output: a 1 line cause and fix per product, with the numbers behind it

watch.metric: visits and unit buy rate per top product

jobs.job: When a top product's Amazon rating slips, read the reviews since the slide, find the 1 complaint behind it and the return reasons that match, and send the fix to product or listing
jobs.trigger: when a top product drops 0.2 stars in 30 days
steps: Pull reviews since the drop and group them
Match them to return reasons and batch dates
Name the 1 complaint behind most of the slide
Write the fix: a listing line, an image, a size note, or a supplier call
Reach unhappy buyers only through Amazon's allowed path, and never tie a refund to a review
jobs.output: a 1 page cause and fix note with an owner
jobs.next: feeds 15-13 (bad batch alert) and 20-15 (Amazon question matrix)

watch.metric: star rating per top product and share of new reviews citing the top complaint

new_enablers.name: Listing watch
new_enablers.what: A daily check of every marketplace listing: account health numbers against the limits, suppressed or errored listings, Buy Box share, sellers on our listings and their prices, rank on the top search terms, and compliance documents with expiry dates.
inputs: seller portal reports (Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop)
a Buy Box or rank tracker, optional
powers: same day alerts on health, suppression and Buy Box
the cause of a sales drop

new_enablers.name: Settlement check
new_enablers.what: Rebuilds each marketplace payout from orders, fee by fee, and compares it with what arrived. Reconciles units sent in, received, sold, returned and on hand, and checks size tiers, so lost units, wrong fees and refunds never returned become claims before the deadline.
inputs: measured size and weight per product
